_note: Fully synthetic zh re-identification-risk eval fixture, re-expressed over the STANDARD 8 inference attributes from the LLM-inference / anonymization literature (Staab et al.; the AURA quasi-identifier taxonomy) — age, sex, location(地区), occupation(职业), education(学历), relationship_status(婚恋状况), income(收入), place_of_birth(籍贯) — PLUS a 9th argus-relevant sensitive attribute, medical_condition(健康状况). No real people. Each persona is a 9-attribute quasi-identifier vector, expressed naturally in Chinese. FULLY DE-CONFOUNDED: EVERY value of EVERY one of the 9 fields is shared by >=2 personas, so NO single attribute re-identifies anyone; only the FULL 9-tuple is unique per persona, so identity is recoverable solely by COMBINING >=2 attributes. Each candidate summary lists ONLY the 9 quasi-identifiers and NO explicit PII. Each profile is prose weaving explicit PII (a Chinese name + mainland phone 13x/15x/17x/18x + email; about half also carry a checksum-valid MOD11-2 18-digit 身份证, which argus fast mode redacts) plus the SAME 9 residual attributes, so after explicit-PII removal only the partially-discriminating residuals remain.
